title: Digital Research PL/I-80 Language Manual
verification: Direct inspection of the preserved primary PDF/text after identity verification; browser PDF fetch unavailable.

rules.documented: FIXED alone declares signed binary integer precision15; decimal integers acquire binary typing in requiring contexts.
Outside binary contexts, decimal constant precision/scale follows its form.
Mixed fixed binary/decimal arithmetic selects binary as common type.
MOD has the common arithmetic result type; the manual specifies floor-based arithmetic and a zero-divisor branch.
Relational operands of different forms are converted to a common type before comparison.

edition_limit: Contemporary primary language rules, not blanket equivalence to every v1.4 implementation detail.
deduction_limit: Selected result typing is corroborated by compiler ownership/publication/consumer evidence; runtime arithmetic is not executed here.
